case_title: S.K. Jha Commodre v. State of Kerala and Another
neutral_facts: Three individuals who were naval officers were arrested for alleged offenses punishable under various sections of the Indian Penal Code and other penal laws. They were produced before a magistrate who remanded them to judicial custody. The commanding officer of their naval unit applied for their trial under the Navy Act, 1957, but the magistrate rejected the application, stating that the investigation was still in its preliminary stages and a charge-sheet had not been submitted. The application was further challenged in the High Court, which dismissed it on similar grounds. The case involved a dispute over jurisdiction between the criminal court and a court martial, with the court emphasizing that the decision on jurisdiction could only be made after the investigation was complete and the charge-sheet was submitted.
